name: test_start_limits_recent_context_without_deleting_board_history
actual_assertion_scope: start默认0不自动带公屏历史，显式3/1/0按需投影，完整read仍有4消息。

name: test_negative_start_context_limit_fails_before_recovery
actual_assertion_scope: 负board-limit在恢复目录前拒绝。

name: test_automatic_actor_is_stable_and_creates_no_work_branch
actual_assertion_scope: 合成对话自动R-UUID稳定，不产生旧wcg/work分支；这不是当前Boss身份规则。

name: test_legacy_branch_migration_preserves_commit_index_and_dirty_files
actual_assertion_scope: 旧wcg/work提交祖先、index、未暂存/未跟踪内容、peer和本地recovery ref在迁移main时保留。

name: test_start_recovers_missing_repo_remembers_role_and_external_path
actual_assertion_scope: 缺repo恢复、001身份/外部文件路径记忆、重复相同身份、拒绝换002，敏感合成串不入config/输出。

name: test_existing_dirty_clone_is_preserved_when_starting
actual_assertion_scope: 已有clone的staged/unstaged/untracked bytes在start保留。

name: test_missing_invalid_and_in_repo_credentials_fail_early
actual_assertion_scope: 缺/坏/多个匹配/仓库内/过期凭据文件早失败，不替换原路径或改发。

name: test_sync_preserves_staged_unstaged_and_untracked_work
actual_assertion_scope: sync保分层dirty/untracked内容并取peer，不留自己的临时stash。

name: test_committed_conflict_aborts_merge_and_restores_dirty_work
actual_assertion_scope: 提交冲突abort且HEAD/dirty/index/untracked保留，无MERGE_HEAD残留。

name: test_uncommitted_conflict_keeps_complete_backup_and_local_bytes
actual_assertion_scope: 恢复未提交内容冲突时保完整stash和双方内容，重试明确因unmerged停止。

name: test_sync_preserves_preexisting_stash
actual_assertion_scope: 用户原stash不被本次sync清掉。

name: test_read_and_multiple_senders_share_topic_without_registration
actual_assertion_scope: 两个clone同题无注册发送，actor/事件顺序明确、无members/ideas。

name: test_checkpoint_pushes_and_result_asset_can_be_sent_with_saved_configuration
actual_assertion_scope: checkpoint实际文件SHA/远端commit、result引用及重放保存，文本“证书”不证明数学。

name: test_new_archive_checkpoint_uses_saved_topic_scope
actual_assertion_scope: 新CAG存档默认范围取本题/本人workspace，旧WC/peer草稿留本地。

name: test_existing_legacy_binding_is_not_changed_and_explicit_shared_keeps_legacy_scope
actual_assertion_scope: 既有shared绑定不改，保持旧scope；拒绝强改CAG。

name: test_unknown_archive_does_not_inherit_a_registered_topic_entry
actual_assertion_scope: 未知save不自动继承已注册题目入口。

name: test_uploaded_standalone_restores_missing_clone_with_current_topic_defaults
actual_assertion_scope: 上传非可执行root恢复空clone并建当前workspace；legacy显式--branch main，main版无该额外参数。

name: test_bootstrap_checkpoint_default_and_known_research_entries_cannot_drift
actual_assertion_scope: 根/checkpoint默认save及RESEARCH_ENTRIES常量一致，所列路径只检查is_file，不验证文档数学。

name: test_all_three_roles_are_bound_and_return_their_exact_prompt
actual_assertion_scope: boss/cleaner/editor按各自clone稳定绑定/精确prompt路径，拒绝角色切换。

name: test_old_um_binding_retains_topic_scope_and_entry
actual_assertion_scope: UM绑定保持UM入口和scope，CAG草稿留本地，拒绝换save。

name: test_legacy_work_path_forwards_to_the_single_root_implementation
actual_assertion_scope: 旧tools/work.py实际转交根实现可读取同fixture公屏。

name: test_missing_repo_and_nonempty_destination_report_actionable_errors
actual_assertion_scope: 缺repo/非空目标给明确错误并保keep文件。

name: test_sync_and_checkpoint_share_writer_lock
actual_assertion_scope: sync/checkpoint共用同clone writer锁。

name: test_inherited_git_routing_does_not_touch_external_index
actual_assertion_scope: 继承Git路由不改外部诱饵index。

name: test_uploaded_nonexecutable_program_works_as_git_askpass
actual_assertion_scope: 上传带空格且不可执行root通过临时可执行ASKPASS回合成字符串；Git credential fill不作网络认证。

name: test_pending_retry_discard_and_replay_keep_original_message_id
actual_assertion_scope: pending/retry/discard保持原ID，未知父回帖留pending，重试仍拒绝，discard不删已有远端消息。

name: test_new_conversation_defaults_to_shared_long_lived_branch_and_cleanup
actual_assertion_scope: 新项目默认长期cleanup分支/专用board/repository-cleanup/cleaner；另研究save可共用分支/board，不额外建远端ref。

name: test_same_downloaded_bootstrap_hands_off_to_updated_github_program
actual_assertion_scope: 同一下载bootstrap在本地假Git远端两次更新根程序后各handoff到first/updated，上传文件字节不变、actor稳定。

name: test_cleanup_branch_clones_checkpoints_and_peer_sync_leave_main_unchanged
actual_assertion_scope: 绑定cleanup两个clone的保存/asset/peer同步留main不动，main另前进也不混入cleanup。

name: test_new_board_is_independent_and_init_does_not_erase_either_board
actual_assertion_scope: 新旧board分离，各init不清消息。

name: test_bound_clone_refuses_branch_or_board_rebinding_and_retains_bytes
actual_assertion_scope: 拒绝重绑文件/board路线，错分支sync/checkpoint/workspace失败且未完成字节保留。

name: test_first_publication_requires_explicit_create_and_stays_off_main
actual_assertion_scope: 首次发布必须显式create，未授权时无新ref，授权后实际branch描述符且main不动。

name: test_first_publication_audits_all_unpublished_commits
actual_assertion_scope: 首次发布同样审计所有未发布祖先，scope外旧commit不能搭便车。

name: test_visit_uses_bound_branch_and_can_explicitly_read_main
